paras: South of Red Rocks, Lorekeeper Raintotem tends Mulgore’s sacred burial grounds. He asks travelers to drive off Bristleback quilboar disturbing them.

Lorekeeper Raintotem tends his people’s sacred burial grounds near Red Rocks in Mulgore. Bristleback Interlopers disturb the resting place, and he asks travelers to drive them away so the ancestors may rest in peace.

Lorekeeper Raintotem watches over the burial sites at Red Rocks. Bristleback quilboar disturb the resting places of tauren chieftains and shamans. Raintotem calls on travelers to restore quiet and dignity to the grounds and their dead.
